description: This file defines API routes/endpoints for managing customer service requests using the FastAPI framework. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, listing, and getting history of service requests. The file imports schemas, services, and errors from the core module, utilizes dependency injection with a singleton repository, and sets up an API router with various HTTP methods and paths.

methods.name: RequestService get_service()
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of RequestService, initializing an in-memory repository if not already created.

methods.name: ServiceRequestOut create_request( payload: ServiceRequestCreate, svc: RequestService = Depends(get_service) )
methods.description: Creates a new customer service request using data from the request payload.

methods.name: ServiceRequestOut get_request( id: str = Path(..., description="The unique identifier of the service request"), svc: RequestService = Depends(get_service), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific service request by its ID.

methods.name: ServiceRequestOut update_request_status( payload: StatusUpdateCreate, id: str = Path(..., description="The unique identifier of the service request"), svc: RequestService = Depends(get_service), )
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing service request.

methods.name: ServiceRequestListResponse list_requests( status: Optional[StatusEnum] = Query(None, description="Optional status filter"), q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Optional free-text search"), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), svc: RequestService = Depends(get_service), )
methods.description: Lists service requests with optional filtering by status and search query, with pagination.

methods.name: ServiceRequestHistoryResponse get_request_history( id: str = Path(..., description="The unique identifier of the service request"), svc: RequestService = Depends(get_service), )
methods.description: Retrieves the history of status changes for a specific service request.
